Definition: nudity, literally (especially the pudenda) or figuratively (disgrace, blemish)
BiblicalUsage: 1) nakedness, nudity, shame, pudenda; 1a) pudenda (implying shameful exposure); 1b) nakedness of a thing, indecency, improper behaviour; 1c) exposed, undefended (fig.)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
